$comment: What the Export tab offers. needs: a key of GET /api/export/:id 'has' (any one of them is enough). opens: which programs read the file.

formats.name: Video (MP4)
formats.what: The finished video with its visuals, ready to upload. Before the visuals are done this is the approved rough.
formats.opens: Every player, YouTube and every editor.
formats.missing: There is no video yet: the rough cut makes one.

formats.name: Subtitles (SRT)
formats.what: What is said, timed to the video: the video's own caption lines when they cover the talk, else every spoken word in short lines. Fillers are left out.
formats.opens: YouTube Studio (Subtitles, Upload file, With timing), video players, and every editor.
formats.missing: There are no words yet: they come when the rough is handed over.

formats.name: Edit list (FCPXML 1.10)
formats.what: The approved cut as a timeline: one clip per kept stretch, linked to your original footage, so you can keep editing it by hand. The visuals are not in it.
formats.opens: Final Cut Pro 10.6 or newer (File, Import, XML) and DaVinci Resolve (File, Import, Timeline).
formats.missing: There is no edit list yet: the rough cut writes it.

formats.name: Edit list (OpenTimelineIO)
formats.what: The same cut as an OpenTimelineIO timeline: one video track and one audio track, linked to your footage.
formats.opens: DaVinci Resolve 18.5 or newer (File, Import, Timeline) and any tool built on OpenTimelineIO.
formats.missing: There is no edit list yet: the rough cut writes it.

formats.name: Chapters (YouTube)
formats.what: The timestamp lines for the video description (0:00 Intro, 1:15 ...), from video/out/chapters.json when the agent or you wrote one, else drafted from the spoken words: check the titles. YouTube shows chapters from at least three, the first at 0:00, each 10 s or longer.
formats.opens: Paste them into the description in YouTube Studio. Also saved as a .chapters.txt file.
formats.missing: There are no words yet to draft chapters from: they come when the rough is handed over.

formats.name: MP4 copies of recordings
formats.what: Recordings in a container some editors do not import (.mkv and others) copied as .mp4 into export/media/, with no re-encode and every sound track kept. FCPXML and OTIO then link the copies: make this first, then make the edit list again.
formats.opens: Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve and any program that wants .mp4 footage.
formats.missing: Nothing to copy: every recording is already an .mp4 or .mov, or there is no edit list yet.
